title: Murder Most Electric
summary: A man is found electrocuted at a substation. A blackout is what alerted them to the murder.
method: The victim was electrocuted before the blackout, establishing the killer's alibi. The killer set up a short circuit by using a bucket of water and a live wire at a nearby restaurant.
motive: The victim was about to reveal his cryptocurrency money and the killer didn't want this money split amongst more people.
killer: The girl the victim had an affair with
